item.title: [English] [Web Series] East of Eden
item.description:
Source91Mobiles Series
LanguageEnglish
CategoryWeb Series
Release Date01 Oct 2026

This adaptation of John Steinbeck's masterpiece explores the multigenerational saga of the Trask family against the backdrop of the Salinas Valley in California. The series places a renewed focus on one of literature's most compelling antiheroes, Cathy Ames, whose ambition and ruthlessness shape the lives of those around her.
